Connect Forgejo to CircleCI. Needs Forgejo 16 or later.

Create a bot user
  As a site admin, create a dedicated user, e.g. CircleCI-bot. In acme, make a team
  with Specific repositories and Read access, then add the bot and your repos to it.
  For a user-owned repo, add the bot as a collaborator instead.

Add the connection integration
  Signed in as the bot: Settings → Authorized Integrations → Add → Generic JWT.
    Name:          CircleCI connection
    Issuer:        https://oidc.circleci.com/org/a0000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000d001
    Claim rules:   {"rules":[{"claim":"sub","compare":"eq","value":"circleci/soc-integrations/forgejo/connection"}]}
    Capabilities:  user Read, organization Read, repository Read and write
  Then copy the Audience it generates (--connection-audience).

Add the checkout integration
  Signed in as the bot: Settings → Authorized Integrations → Add → Generic JWT.
    Name:          CircleCI checkout
    Issuer:        https://oidc.circleci.com/org/a0000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000d001
    Claim rules:   {"rules":[{"claim":"sub","compare":"eq","value":"circleci/soc-integrations/forgejo/checkout"}]}
    Capabilities:  repository Read
  Then copy the Audience it generates (--checkout-audience).
